title: Only 3% Of Adults Can Pass This Pilot Entrance Exam
summary: Explore Flight Foundations, Weather and Headings, Judgment and Control, Instruments and Conditions, The Final Flight Plan across five six-question rounds.

landing.intro:

about.body:
Five rounds offer different angles on this challenge: Flight Foundations, Weather and Headings, Judgment and Control, Instruments and Conditions, The Final Flight Plan. Each round contains six distinct questions.

Choose one of four answers and move on automatically. There is no time limit. A short rewarded ad opens the quiz, each next round and the final result. The target is 24 correct answers out of 30. The result describes this quiz attempt only.

For entertainment and general learning only. This is not an official pilot aptitude, licensing, medical, training or employment assessment. Always use approved aviation training and procedures.

steps: Press Start, watch a short rewarded ad and begin.
Choose one answer per question and progress through five rounds.
Complete all 30 questions to reveal your result. You can then unlock the full breakdown.

pilot-q1.question: Which force acts upward against an aircraft’s weight?

pilot-round1-new1.question: Which force opposes motion through the air?

pilot-round1-new2.question: Which instrument shows pitch and bank relative to the horizon?

pilot-round1-new3.question: What does airspeed describe, rather than groundspeed?

answers.a1: Motion relative to the surrounding air

pilot-round1-new4.question: Which conventional control surface primarily controls yaw?

pilot-q3.question: Which cloud type is most strongly associated with thunderstorms and severe turbulence?

pilot-q4.question: A heading of 180 degrees points approximately in which direction?

pilot-round2-new1.question: What does a weather forecast represent?

answers.a1: An informed prediction that should be updated as conditions change

pilot-round2-new2.question: What is visibility in a weather report concerned with?

answers.a1: How far suitable objects can be seen and identified

pilot-round2-new3.question: A heading of 090 degrees points approximately where?

pilot-round2-new4.question: What can a tailwind do to groundspeed at unchanged true airspeed?

pilot-q5.question: Weather is deteriorating faster than forecast and safe margins are shrinking. What is the best general decision?

answers.a1: Reassess early and divert or land while safe options remain
answers.a2: Continue because the original plan must be completed
answers.a3: Descend below safe limits to maintain visual contact
answers.a4: Ignore the trend until conditions become critical

pilot-q6.question: Which primary controls make an aircraft roll?

pilot-round3-new1.question: Why should a pilot use a checklist rather than memory alone?

answers.a1: To support consistent completion of required steps
Understanding relevant conditions and anticipating how they may develop

pilot-round3-new3.question: What does the elevator primarily control on a conventional airplane?

pilot-round3-new4.question: What is a stall primarily associated with?

answers.a1: Exceeding the critical angle of attack

pilot-q7.question: Which instrument shows an aircraft’s rate of climb or descent?

answers.a1: A steady wind that never changes
answers.a2: A measure of cloud height only
answers.a4: A rapid change in wind speed or direction over a short distance

pilot-round4-new1.question: What does a pressure altimeter use to estimate altitude?

pilot-round4-new2.question: Why does an altimeter's pressure setting matter?

answers.a2: It changes the aircraft's actual weight

pilot-round4-new3.question: Why can ice on a wing be hazardous?

answers.a1: It can alter airflow and degrade performance

pilot-round4-new4.question: Which statement about thunderstorms is sound?

answers.a1: They may contain several serious aviation hazards
answers.a2: They affect only aircraft on the ground
answers.a3: They guarantee smooth air above cloud base
answers.a4: They are harmless without visible lightning

pilot-q9.question: A runway numbered 27 is aligned approximately toward which direction?

pilot-q10.question: You notice an unexplained fuel imbalance during flight. What is the best general response?

answers.a1: Assume the gauge will correct itself
answers.a2: Use the checklist, monitor the situation and communicate as required
answers.a3: Switch random systems until it disappears

pilot-round5-new1.question: What should a pilot do if an important radio instruction is unclear?

pilot-round5-new2.question: A route leg is 90 km and groundspeed is 180 km/h. What is the time for that leg?

pilot-round5-new3.question: Why consider alternate destinations before departure?

answers.a1: To preserve options if the original plan becomes unsuitable
answers.a2: To guarantee the first destination is closed

pilot-round5-new4.question: What does a safe plan do when assumptions no longer match observations?

answers.a1: Reassess and adjust while options remain
answers.a2: Continue solely because the plan was written first
answers.a4: Treat schedule pressure as proof of safety
